title: HR Assistant
description:
Edinburgh or Glasgow Hybrid Working Full-Time

I'm working with a respected professional services organisation looking to appoint an HR Assistant to join their established People team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administration skills who is looking to develop a career in HR, or for an experienced HR Administrator seeking a varied role with exposure across the full employee lifecycle.

Key responsibilities:
- Provide HR administration support across the employee lifecycle, ensuring records and documentation remain accurate.
- Act as a first point of contact for HR queries, delivering a professional and responsive service.
- Support recruitment, onboarding and induction activity for new employees.
- Maintain and update the HR system, producing reports and assisting with people data requirements.
- Contribute to HR projects, process improvements, policy updates and wider team initiatives.

What we're looking for:
- Previous administration experience, ideally within HR, recruitment or a people-focused environment.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm in a busy environment.
- Comfortable handling confidential and sensitive information.
- A proactive approach with a willingness to learn and contribute to continuous improvement.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a supportive team where you'll gain broad HR exposure, build new skills and play an important role within a well-established organisation.

To apply for this role, please send your CV or contact Anthony Oliva at Iconic Resourcing for a confidential chat and further details. At Iconic Resourcing, we understand that not all candidates will meet every single desired qualification or skill for the job positions posted on behalf of our clients.

However, if you believe you can add value to the role despite your experience looking a little different from what we've outlined, we would be thrilled to learn more about you.

title: HR Assistant
description:
Temporary HR Assistant

£14.00 - £17.00 per hour DOE Immediate Start Hybrid Temporary, potential to go permanent

We are currently recruiting for a Temporary HR Assistant to join a busy HR team on an immediate basis.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced HR Assistant who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and is confident managing the detail behind busy people processes.

The role will provide essential administrative support to the HR team, with a particular focus on HR compliance, employee records, recruitment administration and data management.

The Role

You will be responsible for supporting the HR team with a range of day-to-day administrative activities, including:
- Maintaining accurate employee and HR records
- Supporting HR compliance and administration processes
- Assisting with recruitment administration and onboarding
- Managing and updating information within the organisation's ATS
- Completing high-volume data entry and ensuring information is accurate and up to date
- Preparing documentation and maintaining HR files
- Supporting the wider HR team with general administration
- Helping to keep HR processes running smoothly during a particularly busy period
- Providing ad-hoc administrative support across the wider People function

About You

We're looking for someone who is organised, reliable and comfortable working at pace, with excellent attention to detail.

You'll ideally have previous experience within an HR administration or HR assistant role and be confident dealing with confidential information and a high volume of administrative tasks.

Experience of recruitment administration would be beneficial, but this is not a sourcing-focused recruitment role. The emphasis is on the administration, compliance and coordination that sits behind the recruitment and HR processes.

You'll also need to be comfortable learning new systems, as the business is implementing a new ATS and full training will be provided.

There is potential for the role to develop into a permanent opportunity for the right person

If you're an experienced HR Assistant who can hit the ground running and enjoys being the person who keeps everything organised behind the scenes, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Residential Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Residential Conveyancing Paralegal
- Annual Salary: Competitive (with annual review and potential bonus)
- Location: North Berwick
- Job Type: Full-time

We are recruiting on behalf of a prestigious law firm known for its expert legal, property, and financial services. They are seeking a Residential Conveyancing Paralegal to strengthen the team based in North Berwick. This role is ideal for someone who is dedicated to providing the highest level of advice and service to clients, and perhaps someone who is currently commuting into Edinburgh and looking for a role which is closer to home.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Act for clients purchasing new homes from housebuilders and handle the sale of their current properties where applicable.
- Take client instructions promptly to ensure progression of missives within required timescales.
- Attend meetings, taking notes as required.
- Maintain up-to-date client files with all correspondence and documents saved appropriately.
- Maintain regular contact with housebuilders' agents, sending weekly reports to ensure all parties are updated on progress.
- Draft legal documentation, including reporting on title to clients.
- Handle all aspects of the conveyancing process in purchases, sales, and, where applicable, re-mortgages.
- Manage post-settlement work, with the support of a Conveyancing Assistant.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience as a Paralegal within Residential Conveyancing.
- Strong understanding of the conveyancing process.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
- Commitment to maintaining high standards of client service.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with annual review and potential bonus based on performance.
- 32 days holiday per year, including Bank Holidays.
- Birthday off.
- 3x Death in Service Benefits.
- Hybrid Working options.
- Membership of an occupational pension scheme.
- Wellbeing initiatives and access to an online Health Provider.

To apply for this Residential Conveyancing Paralegal position, please submit your CV or reach out to Kate Irvine at Reed for more information.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Our client are a leading manufacturer of precision parts for the aerospace industry. They are looking to add a Logistics Coordinator to their team on a permanent basis. This would be a great fit for a meticulous individual who enjoys challenge and variety in their day to day.

Logistics Coordinator
Permanent position
Global manufacturer of precision components
10% matched pension, 25 days holiday & life assurance

Overall Responsibilities of the Position
- Co-ordinate day to day freight, shipping and transport operations.
- Collate and maintain production, inspection and test information.
- Co-ordinate test rings and accurately record and input results.
- Prepare, check and control all shipping and export documentation.
- Ensure compliance with relevant export control and customs requirements.
- Support weekend working at month end and undertake overtime requirement to support operational requirements.
- Preparation of Metallographic samples following successful completion of training.

Key Area Responsibilities
- Liaise with shipping and transport providers to co-ordinate the movement of products by road, rail, sea and air.
- Organise miscellaneous transport services to support operational and business requirements.
- Work closely with shipping companies to maximise the efficient use of container and vehicle capacity whilst managing transportation costs effectively.
- Prepare and maintain all required certification, shipping, and export documentation, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
- Maintain accurate finished product records using Infoflo and other relevant business systems.
- Ensure records and information are accurate, up to date, secure and readily retrievable.
- Identify and support opportunities for continuous improvements.
- Liaise effectively with sub-contractors and intra-company process personnel to co-ordinate activities and resolve operational requirements.
- Participate in customer inspection and documentation reviews
- Assist with monitoring expenditure against shipping budget and identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency.
- Represent the shipping team at production, planning and other meetings providing updates as required.

Knowledge and Experience
- Good understanding of the overall product process is preferred.
- Excellent attention to detail with a high level of accuracy
- Strong IT skills to include Microsoft Office
- Previous experience of ERP systems
- Ability to understand and work to budgetary constraints
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Excellent communication skills, with confidence to liaise effectively with external agencies, freight providers, subcontractors and internal stakeholders.
- Experience of quality auditing is desirable
- Previous export compliance experience desirable
- Ability to use initiatives and respond effectively to changes, issues or deviations from planned activities.
- Strong organisation and time-management skills with the ability to prioritise competing demands and meet tight deadlines.
- Comfortable communicating and working effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels within the organisation.

Working Hours:
Monday - Thursday 8am - 4:15pm
Friday 8am - 3:15pm

Benefits
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- 10% matched pension
- 3x annual salary life assurance
- Profit related bonus scheme

This position is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) which requires the jobholder to obtain certain authorisation or security clearances that will require interface with local and U.S. government authorities.
